title: Structured browser actuation
objective: Verify exact page, origin, document generation, node identity, role, state, supported action, workspace, and policy revision immediately before dispatch; consume fresh one-shot approval before mutation; verify postconditions; never auto-retry mutation after dispatch; never silently fall back to coordinates. Password-field filling remains denied unless separately governed later.

include: pre-dispatch verification of page, origin, document generation, node, role, state, supported action, workspace, and policy revision
fresh one-shot approval consumption before mutation
no automatic mutation retry after dispatch
stale, replay, drift, and adversarial tests
exclude: new MCP tools, profiles, or remote authority

authority_delta.filesystem: None beyond the SG-000074 dedicated ephemeral automation profile directory owned by Deskal.
authority_delta.process: None beyond the SG-000074 Deskal-supervised low-authority browser child process family.
authority_delta.network: None beyond SG-000075 governed navigation decisions for the isolated host.
authority_delta.browser: Structured actuation verification policy only. No coordinate fallback and no password fill.
authority_delta.secrets: None. Password content is never actuated and never enters records.
authority_delta.approval: None. Actuation consumes existing fresh approvals; no approval minting.

invariants: every mutation is verified before dispatch and after completion
expired or consumed approvals never authorize mutation
structured failure never authorizes coordinate fallback

acceptance.claim: Pre-dispatch verification binds exact page, origin, document generation, node, role, state, supported action, workspace, and policy revision, proven by mismatch tests.
Fresh one-shot approval is consumed before mutation, postconditions are verified, mutation is never auto-retried, coordinate fallback never engages silently, and password fill is denied.
Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000078: SG-000078 may activate only after SG-000077 closes canonically with verified actuation as its base.

done_when: Verified structured actuation exists with one-shot approval, postconditions, no retry, no coordinate fallback, and no password fill, proven by adversarial tests.
